name: com.woopi.sdk
description: Book host bridge for Woopi interactive books: lets the Woopi platform drive a Unity WebGL book (next/previous/go to page, language, restart) and tells it where its Addressables content is hosted.

samples.description: A minimal complete book: a core scene with the Woopi host, ten dummy page scenes loaded with Addressables, and the adapter. Requires Addressables and the URP 2D renderer.

Reusable pointer interactions with one demo scene each: tap, multi-tap (double / triple / custom count), drag, hold (charge or hold / release) and swipe. Each can let only the closest sprite react or all of them. Requires the Input System.
